about: Moves the opponent's tracking policy can't perform on the R1's motors, measured in mjlab (the training sim) with the stage-2 tracker from 24 starts per clip: the frame (index into the cleaned clip) at which each run fell. Each cut starts ~0.8 s before the cluster of falls. kfab_199 failed everywhere (1/24 runs stayed up) and is dropped. scripts/eval_tracker.py re-measures after retraining.
